hypotheses_PRE_REGISTERED.H1_primary_directional: The reranking recall-loss defect observed at product head e53662be (run 40153908549: verdict PRODUCT_FALSIFIED_RECALL_LOSS, exit 1, 10 discriminating cells, aggregate input_hits 17 vs product_hits 15) PERSISTS at product head 5fb312e4, i.e. this run exits 1 with at least one discriminating cell whose product_retention@20 < input_retention@20.
hypotheses_PRE_REGISTERED.H1_null_reported_exactly_as_measured: If this run exits 0 (BENCHMARK_VALID_NO_FALSIFICATION), the honest statement is 'the frozen recall-loss rule is not violated on these 24 cached cells at product head 5fb312e4' - a CHANGE relative to 40153908549 that must be published side by side with the prior verdict. It is NEVER reported as absolute retrieval quality, as a bar being met, or as retrieval working.
hypotheses_PRE_REGISTERED.H2_non_vacuity: The run is only consumable if the instrument's own controls all pass (failed_controls empty) AND n_discriminating_cells > 0; otherwise the verdict is NOT_MEASURED / VACUOUS / ENVIRONMENT_ERROR (exit 2 or 3) and is never a pass.
hypotheses_PRE_REGISTERED.H3_environment: The producer image lacks numpy/scipy/sklearn, which product.query.retrieval's import chain requires (product/query/qmap.py imports numpy; product/query/relevance.py imports sklearn). They are installed this run from the free public package index BEFORE execution, at the exact versions the prior accepted run 40153908549 disclosed (numpy 2.5.4, scipy 1.18.1, sklearn 1.9.1), so the numeric environment is version-identical to the record being compared against. No BLAS/thread pin is claimed and NO byte-identity across machines is asserted (factory-wide requirement 30).

success_rule_UNCHANGED_FROM_FROZEN: exit 0 BENCHMARK_VALID_NO_FALSIFICATION iff (a) every discriminating cell product_retention@20 >= input_retention@20; (b) micro-aggregate product_hits@20 >= input_hits@20 over discriminating cells; (c) no language with input_hits@20 > 0 has product_hits@20 < input_hits@20. Any violation exits 1 PRODUCT_FALSIFIED_RECALL_LOSS. NOT_MEASURED_VACUOUS / ENVIRONMENT_ERROR exits 2 or 3 and is never a pass.
falsification_rule_UNCHANGED_FROM_FROZEN: A single discriminating cell with product_retention@20 < input_retention@20 falsifies the product's reranking leg on that cell; the micro-aggregate and language legs are evaluated by the same frozen rule text. No threshold, k value, population member or ground-truth id is introduced, removed or re-tuned by this run.

comparison_to_40153908549_PRE_REGISTERED.rule: Every compared field is published side by side. A difference is reported as a CHANGE attributable to the product-head advance e53662be -> 5fb312e4, never hidden, never averaged, and never used to soften either verdict.
